sacrestano.aspetto: a grotesque but almost photographic short, plump, soft old man in his seventies, healthy and well fed: a perfectly round pale face with pink cheeks, a tiny pursed mouth, enormous thick round black-rimmed glasses that magnify his pale eyes hugely, thick black dyed hair combed flat with brilliantine; in a black cardigan buttoned over a white shirt closed up to the neck, holding a big iron ring of old keys

parti.occhi: His pale eyes are hugely magnified behind the thick round lenses of his black-rimmed glasses, so big that they fill the lenses; the whites are clear: no fever, no sweat.
parti.occhi_febbre: His pale eyes, hugely magnified behind the thick round lenses, are glassy and red-rimmed with fever; beads of sweat on his forehead under the dyed black hair.
parti.bocca: A tiny pursed mouth with thin pale lips in a round, soft, pink face; healthy; nothing unusual.

collo.inquadratura: his soft, plump neck and the collar of his white shirt buttoned up to the throat
collo.segni: A thin black cord around his neck disappears under the buttoned collar of the shirt; the skin is soft and pale: no swelling, no lumps.

collo_febbre.inquadratura: his soft, plump neck and the collar of his white shirt, unbuttoned, the cord pulled aside
collo_febbre.segni: Under the jaw a hard, swollen lump the size of a walnut, red and shiny: a plague bubo just beginning; the skin wet with sweat.

mani.inquadratura: both his soft white hands held out in front, backs up, from the wrists to the fingertips
mani.segni: Soft, white, plump hands with short clean nails and a little white candle wax under them; on the back of the right hand, three long parallel scratches, red and fresh, as if made by fingernails.

giona.aspetto: a grotesque but almost photographic giant in his forties: an enormous heavy body with huge shoulders and enormous hands, but a strangely small shaved round head with small ears close to the skull, small gentle eyes, red flushed cheeks, a wide mouth slightly open; in a grey ribbed knitted sweater too small for him and brown corduroy trousers

parti.occhi: Small, gentle eyes in the small shaved head, glassy and red-rimmed with fever; the forehead shines with sweat and the cheeks are flushed red.
parti.bocca: A wide mouth, slightly open; healthy teeth; the lips dry and cracked from fever; nothing else.

collo.inquadratura: the side of his thick neck under the small shaved head, the collar of the grey sweater pulled down
collo.segni: Under the jaw a hard swollen lump the size of a walnut, red and shiny: a plague bubo just beginning; the skin wet with sweat.

mani.inquadratura: his huge right forearm and hand, the sleeve of the grey sweater pushed up to the elbow, a dirty strip of cloth unwound from the forearm
mani.segni: On the inside of the forearm, a human bite: two curved rows of small tooth marks, swollen, red and crusted, a few days old; the hand is enormous, with thick calluses and red rope burns across the palm.
